text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello successfully lobbies the academy to gather the student body for an information session.

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student A
text_block_list.text: …An info session for the Grand Concert?

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student B
text_block_list.text: Oh, the thing everyone was talking about for a while? I think my friend volunteered to help, like, reboot it or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student C
text_block_list.text: Didn't it blow up in some controversy, though? Besides, a concert just sounds like a lot of work.

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student D
text_block_list.text: Why do we need another concert anyway? We already have winning concerts.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In favor, against… uninterested. Opinions are varied.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We have to share how we feel about it first. Then… well, they can form their own opinions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Why must obtaining consent be so bothersome?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And the real bother is that this experiment simply cannot happen without it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: For we have a hypothesis to test: can the "potential" of concerts induce growth in other Umamusume as well?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, Tachyon… Remember what you said when you invited me to join this project?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You said you knew what I'd learn from this experience. And that's why you wanted to help.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, what of it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Does that mean you also—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Shh, it's about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone. My name is Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: This may seem out of the blue, but what do we all think about winning concerts?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: My grandmother always told me that they're a chance to give thanks, so I should sing with gratitude for all the people who support my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: But some runners never get to sing. I was one of them.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And so, I envisioned a stage where everybody, even girls like me, would get an equal opportunity to convey their gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I thought that if there was no winning or losing, everyone could sing with a smile on their face.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: …But I was wrong. I forgot something important about us.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Winning concerts are special to us Umamusume. They are the stages of our dreams, and always should be.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: But still, I… I wanted to see her shine!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I saw how hard she danced in the spotlight's shadow. I saw her crying all alone when she failed to place.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I saw her step down from the stage without once standing at its center… But I wanted to see her sing! I wanted to scream at the top of my lungs for her!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Because I was her fan…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I know this is a selfish request, but I make it not as one of you, but as a fan!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I want you all to do this concert! I want to create a space where we can convey all of our feelings to each other freely!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Because to us, each and every one of you is a star.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: In our eyes, there are no backup dancers; there are only lead performers, each deserving of her own spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I want to see all of you shining on stage at the Grand Concert as the stars of the show!

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student B
text_block_list.text: I don't know…

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student B
text_block_list.text: She says it's for the fans, but then what's the point of winning concerts?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh dear…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If I could have your attention… Winning concerts are, indeed, the proper venue for conveying gratitude to our fans.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Tachyon?! What are you—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But is gratitude all you wish to convey in a concert?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hello has spoken! The fans have spoken! "Congratulations"? "You ran well"? They have more to say than this…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I want you center stage." "You'll always be my number one." "I never want to stop watching over you."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "You are the one and only star in my eyes." These are the self-absorbed sentiments they wish to convey!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And what about you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do your egos not desire to convey anything other than a trite "Thank you for helping me win"?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I want to tell my fans that I've come home to them, and thank them for waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I see… Anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student A
text_block_list.text: …I want them to look at me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? Your voice is so quiet all of a sudden. Perhaps you don't feel so strongly about the matter?

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student A
text_block_list.text: I want them to look at me! I want to scream, "Look at me! Follow me! Cheer only for me!"

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student B
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are you—

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student C
text_block_list.text: And I want to tell them that I'm not done yet! That no matter how many times I lose, I have a goal, and I won't give up on it no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student C
text_block_list.text: So until then, no matter what happens, stay with me—run with me! That's what I want to say!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh… Yes, there's that passion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do you see now? The Grand Concert is of an altogether different nature than winning concerts!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The Grand Concert is not so noble. Rather, it is an arena where egos clash—yours and your fans'!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It is no place for such niceties as "thank you" or "congratulations," but a crucible of desires. "I want to win." "You better win." "Watch me." "Don't stop."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …A crucible of dreams, if you will.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A space for all Umamusume and their fans to confess their dreams, nurture them, and bring to life the possibilities therein.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Need I remind you? The resonance observed between a racer and her fans generates energy capable of opening the most impossible and reckless of doors.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now what if the Grand Concert could strengthen and deepen that resonance?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What if it could generate such an explosion of passion as to transform your current limits—indeed, transform everything?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh… Irresistible, is it not? Best make full use of it, I say!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Use it not for your fans, but for yourself—for the sake of broadening your own potential!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That passion will serve you well.

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student B
text_block_list.text: …Will it really make us stronger? Can we really join the concert just for that?

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student D
text_block_list.text: Um… do you think I could transform myself too?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, well, well. Who knew you were all so selfish? Whether you have a message to convey or simply want to get better, your reasons for performing matter not.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I might add that we already have data gathered from yours truly. Performing has been observed to have a positive effect on times.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, and not only that…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I myself have observed a marked change in at least one subject.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Change can come to me… or any of us.

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student A
text_block_list.text: I kinda want to give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student C
text_block_list.text: …Me too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What starts as a few murmurs here and there gradually grows into a wave that sweeps across the room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello's plea seems to have resonated with the students.
